method_card.objective: Acquire the selected PDB deposition of a human PCNA trimer as an immutable original.
method_card.mechanism: Supply one archive request or candidates.json and entry_id. Download original asymmetric-unit mmCIF from RCSB through Clash. Verify accession, revision, species and polypeptide mappings, and three model 1 PCNA label chains in a common assembly operation.
method_card.estimator: Exact original bytes, SHA-256, archive revision and available primary publication DOI; partners and apo status require separate assessment. Read structure-context.json for deposition-reported non-PCNA polymer identities, ligand annotations, experiment and resolution.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Archive metadata and deposited coordinates; no trained model.

manifest.licence: GX release source; archived material retains the archive terms.
manifest.licence_basis: UniProt and wwPDB supply the original metadata and the deposited coordinates.
manifest.limitations: Requires a public human P12004 deposition with three model-1 polypeptide chains in a shared deposited assembly operation. Co-deposited ligands and other polymers do not establish direct binding, apo state, function or geometry.
